items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: Yeah. With Buddy Young and Motley.

ctx.x: And you broadcast from the Great Lakes and had the greatest football team in the world.
Yeah. With Buddy Young and Motley.
Marion Motley and Paul Brown was the coach. That was the first I heard of him. I didn’t hear of him while he was at Massillon, Ohio. But I heard of him when he was coaching up there.
